description_en: Maize is one of the most important staple crops in Rwanda, grown across all altitude zones.
description_rw: Ibigori ni kimwe mu birimwa by'ibanze byingenzi mu Rwanda, biragundwa mu ntera zose z'uburebure.
common_problems: fall-armyworm | maize-streak-virus | gray-leaf-spot | nitrogen-deficiency | drought-stress | stalk-borer
prevention_tips_en: Use certified seeds from approved suppliers. | Practice crop rotation with legumes. | Monitor fields regularly, especially during early vegetative stages. | Ensure proper spacing to reduce humidity and disease pressure. | Apply fertiliser according to RAB recommendations.
prevention_tips_rw: Koresha imbuto zemerewe zaturutse ku bagemurizi bemerewe. | Hindura imyaka ukoresheje ibibyimba. | Genzura inzu z'imyaka buri gihe, cyane cyane mu bihe bya mbere by'imikurire. | Jya ukora umuzi w'ibigori neza kugira ngo ugabanye ubuhehere n'indwara. | Shira ifumbire hakurikijwe inama za RAB.

description_en: Beans are a primary protein source and cash crop for Rwandan farmers, grown in both seasons.
description_rw: Ibishyimbo ni inkomoko y'ibwoya kandi ni umusaruro w'amafaranga ku barima b'u Rwanda.
common_problems: bean-fly | angular-leaf-spot | bean-rust | pythium-root-rot | potassium-deficiency | waterlogging
prevention_tips_en: Use disease-resistant varieties recommended by RAB. | Avoid planting in poorly drained soils. | Practice crop rotation — do not plant beans in the same field every season. | Inspect young seedlings for bean fly damage within the first two weeks. | Remove and destroy infected plant material.
prevention_tips_rw: Koresha ubwoko bw'imbuto bwuzuye indwara bushyigikiwe na RAB. | Irinde gutera mu butaka butagira imiringoti myiza y'amazi. | Hindura imyaka — ntukore ibishyimbo mu murima umwe buri gihembwe. | Genzura inshyitsi nto ku biribwa by'ibibondo mu cyumweru cya mbere n'icya kabiri. | Vana kandi ukumbye ibimera byanduye.

description_en: Cassava is a drought-tolerant food security crop grown widely in lower-altitude Rwanda.
description_rw: Imyumbati ni umusaruro w'umutekano w'ibiribwa ushobora guhangana n'amapfa, uragundwa cyane mu ntera zaba hasi mu Rwanda.
common_problems: cassava-mosaic-disease | cassava-brown-streak | cassava-mealybug | whitefly | zinc-deficiency | waterlogging
prevention_tips_en: Use CMD-resistant and CBSD-tolerant varieties. | Only plant certified, disease-free cuttings. | Remove and destroy mosaic-infected plants immediately. | Control whitefly populations which spread mosaic virus. | Avoid introducing planting material from infected areas.
prevention_tips_rw: Koresha ubwoko bwuzuye CMD no kugumya CBSD. | Tera gusa gacaca emerewe, nta ndwara. | Vana kandi ukumbye imyumbati yanduye indwara ya mosaic vuba. | Genzura inyoni zo gutera amata mu buhehere zivura virusi ya mosaic. | Irinde gutera gacaca iturutse mu turere twanduye.

description_en: Irish potato is a major cash and food crop grown primarily in the high-altitude regions of Rwanda.
description_rw: Ibirayi ni umusaruro w'amafaranga n'ibiribwa by'ingenzi biragundwa cyane mu turere two hejuru mu Rwanda.
common_problems: late-blight | early-blight | potato-virus-y | aphids | phosphorus-deficiency | frost-damage
prevention_tips_en: Use certified, blight-resistant seed tubers. | Apply copper-based fungicides preventively during rainy seasons. | Earthing up reduces tuber exposure to blight spores. | Avoid overhead irrigation which promotes blight spread. | Inspect fields twice weekly during high blight risk periods.
prevention_tips_rw: Koresha imbuto z'ibirayi emerewe, zuzuye late blight. | Koresha ubuvuzi bwa fungicide ya kobre mbere y'igihe mu bihe by'imvura. | Kubita ubutaka munsi y'ibirayi bigabanya kubonekera kwa blight ku cyori. | Irinde gusukura amazi mu bwirukane bibasha gutera blight gukwirakwira. | Genzura inzu z'imyaka inshuro ebyiri mu cyumweru mu bihe bya blight bya hejuru.

description_en: Tomatoes are grown as a cash crop across Rwanda, particularly in lowland and valley areas.
description_rw: Inyanya ziragundwa nk'umusaruro w'amafaranga mu Rwanda hose, cyane cyane mu turere two hasi no mu biyaga.
common_problems: early-blight | late-blight | tomato-leaf-miner | whitefly | bacterial-wilt | blossom-end-rot | magnesium-deficiency
prevention_tips_en: Use grafted or resistant tomato varieties for blight-prone areas. | Practice crop rotation — avoid planting in fields with recent solanaceous crops. | Install yellow sticky traps to monitor and reduce whitefly populations. | Avoid excessive nitrogen which promotes vegetative growth over fruiting. | Ensure adequate calcium availability to prevent blossom end rot.
prevention_tips_rw: Koresha ubwoko bw'inyanya yashongewe cyangwa yuzuye indwara mu turere two kugirwa n'indwara ya blight. | Hindura imyaka — irinde gutera mu mirima yari ifite ibimera bya solanaceous vuba aha. | Shira imishono ishungura umuhondo kugira ngo urebe kandi ugabanye inyoni zo gutera amata mu buhehere. | Irinde azote nyinshi zitera imikurire y'amashami aho gutera imbuto. | Menya neza ko kalisiyo ihari bihagije kugira ngo wirinde kurota kw'imbuto.
